title.zh: 相似与缩放 · 长度、面积、体积各变几倍
title.en: Similarity & Scaling · Lengths, Areas and Volumes Each Change Differently

description.zh: 放大 k 倍：长度×k、面积×k²、体积×k³，形状和角度不变。巨人例子里的骨强与体重关系是示意简化。
description.en: Enlarging by k multiplies lengths by k, areas by k² and volumes by k³ while shape and angles stay. The bone-strength example is an illustrative simplification.

formula: L × k, A × k², V × k³

reason.zh: 小孔成像里物与像的比例、影子测高里杆与树的比例，都来自一对相似三角形的对应边成比例。
reason.en: The object-to-image ratio in a pinhole camera and the stick-to-tree ratio in shadow measuring both come from corresponding sides of similar triangles.

title.zh: 为什么放大一倍，面积和体积不止一倍？
title.en: Why do area and volume grow by more than the scale factor?
